items.name: Bone Saw
items.description: The Bone Saw is a finely crafted kukri with an edge so keen it seems to sing through the air. Its blade is slightly curved, resembling the tools used by ancient surgeons. Made from high-quality steel, the weapon features intricate bone-like engravings along the hilt, giving it a macabre yet elegant appearance. The kukri is favored by those who appreciate the precision of surgical strikes, and it is said to have been used by a renowned Chelaxian assassin who left no bone uncut.
